crossRefs.note: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

translations.web: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
translations.bsb: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
translations.kjv: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order my prayer unto thee, and will keep watch.
